slides.title: Understanding Prompting: Your AI Intern
content: Think of an AI like a very smart intern.
It can do amazing things but needs clear instructions.
Prompting is giving those specific instructions.
narration: Imagine an AI model as an incredibly smart and fast intern.
This intern can do many tasks, but needs very specific instructions.
Prompting is simply giving these clear instructions.
A good prompt helps the AI understand exactly what you want.
slides.image_prompt: A friendly, cartoon intern character sitting at a desk, surrounded by thought bubbles showing complex tasks being processed quickly. A speech bubble above their head says 'What can I do for you?'

slides.title: The 3 C's of a Good Prompt: Clarity
content: Clarity: Be specific, not vague.
Weak Prompt: 'Write about electric cars.'
Clear Prompt: 'Write a short blog post on top 3 benefits of electric cars for city dwellers.'
narration: A weak prompt gives a weak answer.
A great prompt uses three key ingredients, our 3 C's.
The first 'C' is Clarity.
Be specific with your instructions.
slides.image_prompt: A magnifying glass highlighting a section of text that is clear and concise, contrasting with blurry text in the background. Shows 'Clarity' as a keyword.

slides.title: The 3 C's: Context and Constraints
content: Context: Give background and audience information.
Example Context: 'For a lifestyle blog on sustainable living.'
Constraints: Set rules for length, format, and tone.
Example Constraints: 'Under 400 words, friendly tone, end with a question.'
narration: The second 'C' is Context.
Tell the AI why you are asking and who the audience is.
Adding 'For a lifestyle blog on sustainable living' provides context.
The third 'C' is Constraints.
These are rules like length, format, or tone.
slides.image_prompt: A Venn diagram showing three overlapping circles labeled 'Clarity', 'Context', and 'Constraints'. The center overlap is labeled 'Excellent Prompt'.

slides.title: Prompting is a Conversation
content: Treat AI interaction as a conversation.
Refine your prompts based on the AI's output.
Example: Ask for a slogan, then ask to make it 'shorter and more modern'.
narration: Remember, your first prompt is rarely your last.
Think of it as a conversation with the AI.
You can refine your prompts based on the AI's initial response.
For instance, you might ask for a slogan.
slides.image_prompt: Two speech bubbles showing a back-and-forth conversation, with the second speech bubble showing a refinement or improvement over the first. Illustrated with a person and a robot icon.

slides.title: Key Takeaways
content: Good prompts need Clarity, Context, and Constraints.
Clarity means being specific.
Context gives background and audience details.
Constraints set rules for the output.
Refine your prompts through conversation.
narration: Let's quickly recap what we have learned.
To get good results from AI, your prompts need three things:
Clarity, meaning be specific.
Context, giving background and audience information.
And Constraints, setting rules for the output.
Also, remember to refine your prompts by having a conversation with the AI.
slides.image_prompt: A concise mind map connecting 'Good Prompt' to three branches: 'Clarity', 'Context', 'Constraints', and a separate branch for 'Iterative Prompting' with an arrow leading back to 'Good Prompt'.

slides.title: Your Assignment
content: Open an AI chatbot (like Gemini or ChatGPT).
Create a prompt combining Clarity, Context, and Constraints.
Example: 'Act as a chef. Give a simple 3-step recipe for masala chai, for someone who is new to cooking. Present it as a numbered list.'
Experiment and refine your prompt until you get a good result.
narration: Now for a small assignment to practice your new skills.
Open your chosen AI chatbot.
Your task is to create a prompt using Clarity, Context, and Constraints.
Here is a prompt example:
Instruct the AI to act as a chef.
Ask for a simple 3-step recipe for masala chai, aimed at new cooks.
Finally, request it as a numbered list.
Experiment and refine your prompt.
slides.image_prompt: A person looking at a laptop screen with an AI chatbot interface, a thought bubble above their head showing a recipe for masala chai. A checkmark indicates successful completion.
